==Tocharian A==

===Etymology===
Related to {{cog|xto|oko||id}}, but through what manner is uncertain. Probably borrowed from {{bor|xto|txb|-}} to Tocharian A, in which case ultimately from {{der|xto|ine-pro|*h₂ógeh₂||berry, fruit}}.

===Noun===
{{head|xto|noun|g=?}}

# [[fruit]]

{{C|xto|Botany|Foods}}

==Tocharian B==

===Etymology===
Related to {{cog|xto|oko||id}}, but through what manner is uncertain. Probably a borrowing from Tocharian B to A. From there, probably ultimately from {{der|txb|ine-pro|*h₂ógeh₂||berry, fruit}}, making it cognate with {{cog|lt|úoga}}, {{cog|ru|я́года}}, {{cog|ang|æcern}} (whence {{cog|en|acorn}}), etc. Also possibly from {{der|txb|ine-pro|*h₂ewg-||increase, grow}}, in which case cognate with {{m|txb|auk-||to grow}}, {{cog|lt|augti}}, {{cog|la|augeo}}, etc.

===Noun===
{{txb-noun||n}}

# [[fruit]]
# [[result]], [[effect]], [[consequence]]

====Derived terms====
* {{l|txb|okotstse||fruitful}}

===Further reading===
* {{R:txb:Adams 2013|oko|page=115}}
